query:
SELECT 
                t.id, 
                t.name, 
                t.created_at, 
                COUNT(DISTINCT nt.note_id) as "note_count!"
            FROM tags t
            LEFT JOIN note_tags nt ON t.id = nt.tag_id
            LEFT JOIN notes n ON nt.note_id = n.id AND n.is_deleted = false
            WHERE t.user_id = $1
            GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.created_at
            ORDER BY t.name ASC
